title: Paranormal fundraiser to unveil these Wilbraham investigations
excerpt: The Friends of Wilbraham Seniors will host the "Who Goes There" Premiere Reveal fundraiser to benefit local senior programs.
content:
Ashley Shook

Updated Mon, September 14, 2026 at 11:41 PM UTC

WILBRAHAM, Mass. (WWLP) - Paranormal investigators will reveal findings from three locations in Wilbraham during a fundraiser event benefiting programs and services for area seniors.

Tickets go on sale for the Incredible Naumkeag Pumpkin Show

The Friends of Wilbraham Seniors will host the "Who Goes There" Premiere Reveal fundraiser on October 16 at the Wilbraham Senior Center. Investigators from Agawam Paranormal will present findings featuring Adams Cemetery, the Block Building, and Taproom Bar and Grill, all in Wilbraham.

Organizers said attendees will hear firsthand accounts from the investigators and three individuals picked from a raffle conducted in May. They will share their experiences during the paranormal excursions.

Paranormal Who Goes There EventDownload

The fundraiser offers two admission options, VIP tickets cost $15 and include entry, a private session with the paranormal team, hands-on experience with investigation equipment, refreshments and reserved seating. General admission tickets are $5 and include access to the premiere reveal presentation.

YouTuber ordered not to trespass at ‘The Conjuring’ house

Tickets must be purchased by October 1. The event will be held from 6:30 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. at the Wilbraham Senior Center. Costumes are encouraged as the event takes place just weeks before Halloween.

Proceeds from the fundraiser will support Friends of Wilbraham Seniors programs and services. For more information, visit Friends of Wilbraham Seniors website.
